answer: Sybil resistance bonds each identity in escrow and links equivocation evidence across the same consensus thread. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, every implicated pair contributes to a quadratic O(k^2) penalty; detection also applies an exponential multiplier e^{αk}, α>0, to the swarm’s forfeiture. Because capital depreciates asymmetrically after slashing, recovery is slower than seizure: dividing stake among ivory- or onyx-labeled keys does not dilute correlated risk.
